response.sql:
WITH language_groups AS (
  SELECT original_language_id,
         AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY original_language_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rental_rate) AS average_of_group_average_rental_rates,
       AVG(film_count) AS average_group_film_count
FROM language_groups;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct original_language_id, including NULL, forms one group; AVG ignores NULL rental rates, and film_count counts qualifying films.
